_README: Curated allowlist of value-less boolean features (passive presence toggles). A value-less enhancement line whose text EXACTLY matches an entry here is parsed as a presence affix {stat, bonus_type: 'boolean', value: 1} instead of being dropped; the solver's highest-of-bucket rule collapses multiple sources to presence (non-stacking). Exclude-until-verified: every entry below is confirmed a genuine passive toggle in the gear-planner Bool set and/or appears value-less in our own seed. Procs, on-hit effects, weapon dice, crafting markers, and clickies are deliberately NOT included. Underscore-prefixed and non-string entries are ignored.
